query:
SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount_gbp), 0) AS "total!: Decimal",
            COUNT(*)                             AS "count!: i64"
        FROM orders o
        JOIN stock    s ON s.id = o.stock_id
        JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id
        WHERE p.farmer_id     = $1
          AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
          AND DATE(o.placed_at) BETWEEN $2 AND $3
